ambient_events: A drawer comes out an inch, is looked into, and goes back.
The thermometer is read and a number is written in the log.
It is very cold in here and very still and the stillness is the point.
Somebody counts under their breath, in tens, and gets to four hundred, and starts again tomorrow.
description:
Cold, dry and dark. Drawers, floor to ceiling, four hundred of them, each labelled with a name and a year and a number that goes down by one or two every season and occasionally back up by a hundred.

This is the single most valuable thing in the region and there is no lock on the door.
name: The Seed Vault
